summary: The candidate rejects the literal co-located pattern plus length-bound schema, but equivalent constraints split across allOf remain admitted and are silently weakened by xgrammar.

tests.what_was_measured: Real xgrammar compilation on the recorded base: original, split-allOf, and ref-split schemas all accepted the invalid short document.
Exact candidate regression suite: 6 passed and 8 subtests passed.
Candidate admission detection rejects the literal schema but misses split-allOf and local-ref split constraints, allowing compiler dispatch.

gpu_execution.evidence: CPU-only schema compiler/admission defect; one gfx950 AMD Instinct MI350X was inventoried but not needed.

remaining_counterexamples: pattern and minLength in separate allOf branches silently accept {"v": "ab"}
pattern and minLength referenced from separate local $defs through allOf silently accept {"v": "ab"}
remaining_limitations: No model-serving or distributed workload was run because the defect is in CPU schema admission/compiler behavior.
The separate Outlines behavior described by the issue was not changed by the candidate and was not qualified here.
No native rebuild was performed because the candidate changes only Python and report/test files.
